term: epistemic admissibility in the two-description control
definition: The Bool epistemic frame admits every candidate description from every origin. This is a stipulated coarse profile and is distinct from the identity relation used as the stronger metaphysical profile.
note: A mathematical control, not a sourced theory of knowledge; no failure-of-proof operator occurs.
